<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 29:1">Targ. Prov. XXIX, 1</cite>. Targ. II Esth. VI, 10 <he>בע׳ בע׳</he> make haste.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:15">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>דלע׳ קא אתית</he> because thou shalt soon come (to us, the dead).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:25">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דלישרוף לע׳</he> in order that he may be burnt to death so much sooner; <cite ref="Pesachim 75a:16">Pes. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דתימות בע׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>לעגל</he>) that she may die the sooner; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 630">Yalk. Lev. 630</cite>; a. e.
